detail: Both React Native targets stay Preview, and this records what executing them actually produced rather than what was hoped for. react-native-ios: the one input the previous record named, a build root outside the /tmp symlink, is supplied, and the Joplin build blocker is closed by execution. Both revisions of joplin-note-row-touch-target-15972, 7d90db0b and 2fa45a5a, reach BUILD SUCCEEDED for the simulator and produce Joplin.app with differing main.jsbundle digests, 096820b5 and 31e0a4f1. CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO is not the recipe: DEVELOPMENT_TEAM has to be forced empty and CODE_SIGN_IDENTITY set to the ad-hoc identity, which keeps the aps-environment and application-group entitlements in the product, and both builds then install and launch on a disposable iOS 26.2 iPhone 16 Pro simulator and stay running on the first-run note list that NoteItem.tsx draws. The simulator was created for this and deleted afterwards. The discriminating tap is not claimed: a first XCUITest attempt failed on a WebDriverAgent port collision with other booted simulators, and with a distinct wdaLocalPort the session started but a predicate on the note row's label never matched a visibly present row, so the row's addressing is unsettled and no reproduction is written up. The target still needs a second independent application because BlueWallet is excluded outright; streetwriters/notesnook is named as the nearest unexplored candidate and is explicitly not claimed. react-native-android: the four application archives the committed runner needed are built, joplin assembleProfileable at de637847 and 623da377 and the MissingCore/Music assembleRelease x86_64 splits at cdd2305a and 5c86ff15, and both campaigns ran for real on a reset pixel_6 AVD on android-36 google_apis x86_64 inside the pinned worker image with Docker network mode none. Both passed their cleanup audit with the AVD gone, no remaining ADB devices, and every owned emulator and Appium process proven gone by start-clock-tick identity, so the ownership and reset half of the runner is executed rather than asserted. Neither reached an observation, and both are recorded as executed and disqualified. The music trigger waits for an ARTISTS tab that does not exist at cdd2305a, where the tabs are HOME, FOLDERS, PLAYLISTS and TRACKS, with the track count still 0, so it is authored against a navigation this revision does not have and does not wait for the media scan. The joplin trigger reaches the Welcome! notebook row and cannot address it: find_node walks up to a clickable ancestor and the React Native touchable sets no clickable attribute, so the walk reaches the boundless root and the long press has no bounds. Two committed-but-uncalled files were exercised for the first time on the way: joplin_profileable_init.gradle, without which the Joplin profileable manifest merger fails on an undefined usesCleartextTraffic placeholder, and generate_react_native_music_fixtures.sh, whose four hashes reproduced byte-exactly under the ffmpeg 7.1.5 it pins. This is maintenance on the validation record: no CLI behaviour changes, no promotion is claimed, and every blocker is restated as the exact remaining input.
